title: A flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv diverts to Saudi Arabia after making distress call
summary: The pilot and co-pilot have been hospitalized after what flydubai described as an onboard "incident" — but what exactly happened is unclear.
contentText:
As the plane went into a spin and began to plunge, a passenger and crew members got into the cockpit, subdued the pilot and diverted the flight to land in Saudi Arabia, Israel's leader says.

(Image credit: Erik Marmor)
